summary: Iteration 4 backend testing complete. Added tests for Apple Sign In config/endpoint and SendGrid graceful no-op driver invite email flow. All 17/17 tests passed including 7 new iter4 tests + 10 regression tests from prior iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1282 lines — approaching the >700 line threshold; recommend splitting into modules (auth, admin, drivers, invites, apple, email).

In create_driver_invite, send_email() receives raw body.email (mixed-case) while stored value is lowercased — minor inconsistency; safe since SendGrid is case-insensitive but could be normalized before send_email call for log/data parity.
email_sent is only set True after successful send, so graceful no-op (no key) correctly leaves it False — verified.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed driver invites and one TEST_ driver user via /driver-invites/accept. No seeded prod data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has TestAppleSignIn and TestDriverInviteEmail classes covering iter4 features. Apple Sign In cannot be end-to-end verified without a real Apple identity token — only 501 unconfigured path is tested. When APPLE_CLIENT_ID or SENDGRID_API_KEY is set, tests for 'unconfigured' Apple and 'no-key' log check will need adjustment. Backend log check reads /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log tail (last 20KB) — resilient to log rotation via FileNotFoundError skip.
